criteria.text: Notes that TNF secretion after lipopolysaccharide is normal.

grounding.quote: produces the normal amount of secreted TNF

criteria.text: Uses the intact lipopolysaccharide-driven TNF to rule out Myd88 deletion.

grounding.quote: MyD88 is required for every lipopolysaccharide-driven cytokine in these cells

criteria.text: Uses the normal STAT3 phosphorylation after recombinant IL-10 to rule out Il10ra deletion and Stat3 deletion.

grounding.quote: adding recombinant IL-10 protein to the cells produces the normal amount of STAT3 phosphorylation

criteria.text: Concludes that the cells cannot make IL-10 but can still respond to it.
